title: Greece Approves 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax as First Framework Lands Below Draft Rate
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Greece Approves 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax as First Framework Lands Below Draft Rate Greece's parliament approved a 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrencies, the country's first dedicated crypto tax framework, with annual gains up to €500 exempt. This post Greece Approves 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax as First Framework Lands Below Draft Rate first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
